term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (s. 21; joint works from death of last surviving author)
moral_rights: Moral rights recognized; exist in perpetuity (secondary summary) (unconfirmed)
fair_use_exceptions: Fair dealing model (ss. 9 and 14); private reproduction, quotation, teaching, libraries and archives, computer programs (ss. 27-37)
enforcement_body: Office of the Administrator and Registrar General (OARG) - National Registry for Industrial Property and Copyright
notes: Act repeals Copyright Act 1965; Part VIII establishes a collecting society; folklore rights vested in the President in perpetuity (s. 26). Non-membership claims come from an undated US trade guide; WPPT unknown; no WIPO list seen.
